situation: You are at a hotel. You arrived two hours before the check-in time.
task: Ask the hotel staff if you can check in early.

situation: You are having lunch at a restaurant. You are thirsty.
task: Ask the waiter for a glass of water.

situation: You are visiting a new town. You want to go to the train station, but you are lost.
task: Ask someone how to get to the station.

situation: You are trying on a shirt in a shop. It is too big for you.
task: Ask the shop assistant for a smaller size.

situation: You are sightseeing with your friend. You want a photo of both of you.
task: Ask someone to take a photo of you and your friend.

situation: You are meeting a friend at 3 p.m. Your bus is delayed. You will arrive ten minutes late.
task: Apologize and tell your friend that you will be ten minutes late.

situation: Someone speaks to you in English, but you do not catch what they say.
task: Ask the person to say it again.

situation: You are at a café. You are allergic to nuts and want to order a cake.
task: Tell the staff about your nut allergy and ask if the cake contains nuts.

situation: You are in class. You forgot your pen and need to write something.
task: Ask your classmate if you can borrow a pen.

situation: You want to go to the movies with your friend this Saturday.
task: Invite your friend to watch a movie with you this Saturday.
